title.zh: ⚡️慢雾PHP漏洞报告：波及Web3链下基础设施，项目方应立即升级至最新版
title.en: ⚡️慢雾PHP漏洞报告：波及Web3链下基础设施，项目方应立即升级至最新版

current_state.zh: SlowMist warned that two critical, already-exploited PHP vulnerabilities (CVSS 9.2) affect all PHP 5.4–8.5.11 deployments and pose systemic risk to Web3 off-chain infrastructure, noting that over half of the 1,488 crypto-related domains it scanned show PHP fingerprints, and urged projects to upgrade immediately to patched releases.
